name: Remote servers
author: Majkelll
description: Keep a list of your own SSH servers in the bar: open a console, watch live load/RAM/uptime, and get told when one drops or comes back. One button sets up key-based auth, so no password is ever stored or asked for again.

barWidget.description: Connect to the SSH servers you list and watch their load, RAM and uptime.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often load/RAM is sampled over ssh while the popup is open. Not sampled at all while closed. Higher than a local plugin's default on purpose, since each sample is a network round trip rather than a local call.

schema.label: Notify when a server drops or comes back
schema.description: Sends a desktop notification the first time a server stops answering, and again when it answers. A server's first reading is the baseline, not news, and nothing is sent while the checks are stopped or the machine itself is offline.
